Introduction

Saja Boys is a five-member fictional kpop boy group created for the 2025 Netflix animated film KPop Demon Hunters. Known as the story’s main antagonists, they appear as a globally famous idol group while secretly working as demons. Their mission is to defeat rival girl group HUNTR/X and take over their massive fanbase.

The group was first introduced in the official teaser released on April 24, 2025. Ahn Hyo Seop voices Jinu, the group’s leader, who combines the charm of an idol with the cunning of a villain. As the film progresses, the Saja Boys emerge as the most serious threat to HUNTR/X, pushing the conflict between pop stardom and supernatural forces to its peak.

On June 19, 2025, creators revealed that the Saja Boys were inspired by several real-world kpop groups and entertainers. Their concept references acts such as BTS, TXT, Stray Kids, ATEEZ, BIGBANG, and MONSTA X. Jinu's design was modeled after actors Cha Eun Woo and Nam Joo-hyuk, while the member Mystery was influenced by anime characters, giving the group a stylized and unique visual identity.
